source: COMPOSED. Rules: function calls arrive as whole functionCall parts per chunk unless the Vertex-only streamFunctionCallArguments opt-in is set (SDK v2.27.0 FunctionCallingConfig / PartialArg); 'When streaming, this signature might be returned in a part with empty text content, so be sure to parse all parts until finish_reason is returned by the model.' (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/thought-signatures, 2026-10-06). Chunk envelope per stream-text.chunks.json. Values invented; 'c2lnLXRleHQ=' / 'c2lnLWNhbGw=' are stand-in base64 signatures.

expect.note: Every part (incl. the empty-text one carrying a signature) must survive into providerData in order, unmerged; no thought/signature content is yielded as a delta.
